(()=>{const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,16/9,.1,3000);const T=RACE.T,N=T.N,k=Math.floor(N*.1875);cam.position.set(T.x[k],T.y[k]+3.2,T.z[k]);const k2=(k+20)%N;cam.lookAt(T.x[k2],T.y[k2]+1,T.z[k2]);cam.updateMatrixWorld();const rc=new THREE.Raycaster();const out=[];for(const [px,py] of [[475,481],[1063,479]]){rc.setFromCamera({x:px/640-1,y:1-py/360},cam);const h=rc.intersectObjects(RACE.scene.children,true)[0];if(h){const o=h.object;out.push([o.name,o.geometry.attributes.position.count,h.point.x.toFixed(1),h.point.z.toFixed(1),h.faceIndex])}}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
